```yaml
name: Update Nix Vendor Hash

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - 'vendor/'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-vendor-hash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install Nix
      uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31

    - name: Run helper script to update vendorHash
      run: |
        ./scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

    - name: Create Pull Request
      id: cpr
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        branch: "update-vendorhash"
        commit-message: "chore: update vendorHash"
        title: "Update vendorHash"
        body: "This PR updates the vendorHash based on current dependencies."
        labels: "auto-generated"

    - name: Check if PR was created
      if: steps.cpr.outputs.pull-request-number != ''
      run: echo "Pull Request created with number: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull-request-number }}"
```
